techParks.name: IBC Knowledge Park
techParks.locality: Bannerghatta Road, S.G. Palya (near Dairy Circle)
techParks.description: Multi-tower IT park at 4/1 Bannerghatta Main Road built around 2004, the corridor's anchor office campus: Accenture's Bannerghatta delivery centre, ACL Digital (Tower D), Ather Energy's corporate office and Byju's shrinking headquarters are here, and Swiggy ran its HQ from Tower D until it moved to Embassy TechVillage. Oracle's own Oracle Technology Park adjoins it to the north. Developer and total area were not confirmed.

techParks.description: Single-tenant campus of Honeywell Technology Solutions Lab at No. 151/1 Doraisanipalya, Bannerghatta Road 560076, the original home of Honeywell's India engineering arm. coverageNotes: LENS: Bannerghatta Road, Bilekahalli, Arekere, JP Nagar, Jayanagar, BTM 2nd Stage, Bommanahalli and Hosur Road to Kudlu Gate. TOOLS: the shared WebSearch budget ran out after my first eleven searches, so most verification was done by fetching company pages directly and by scanning the offline OSM datasets inside the lens bounding box (lat 12.86-12.945, lng 77.56-77.655); several sites could not be read (Oracle 403, Honeywell campus list only, HGS/Cleartrip/Myntra JavaScript-only or down, Mindteck 503, Porter/Safran 403, MetricStream/LAPP/Allegion 404 or rate-limited). Every office whose only source is OSM is marked low. CONFIRMED FROM PRIMARY PAGES (high): Zerodha HQ and Kalyani Vista support centre; IBM India corporate office at Subramanya Arcade; ACL Digital Tower D IBC Knowledge Park; Tally head office AMR Tech Park II and registered office Raheja Arcade; Sagility HQ AMR Tech Park; Clear/ClearTax AMR Block 1; Quinnox AMR Tech Park-4; Softtek Shilpa Emerald; emids Golden Tower; Brillio Bren Optimus; KIOCL Koramangala; WeWork Salarpuria Symbiosis; BHIVE AKR Tech Park; Honeywell Campus 1 Devarabisanahalli. LENS CLAIMS CHECKED AND NOT CONFIRMED (left out): Swiggy's IBC Knowledge Park HQ (Tower D) was given up when it moved to Embassy TechVillage, and its 2026 filing moves the registered office again to Sumadhura Capitol Towers, so it is omitted under rule 5 (the exit predates 2023); Fidelity is at Embassy GolfLinks and Manyata, not IBC; Mindtree/LTIMindtree has no Bannerghatta presence in any source (OSM puts it at Global Village and Hebbal); Infosys shows only in two unlabelled OSM nodes in JP Nagar and an old Deccan Herald mention of Mohan Chambers, no current source, omitted; Mphasis, Zensar, L&T (LTTS lists Bellary Road, RGA Tech Park and Jakkur only), Cognizant, Lowe's (its own site gives Manyata) and Yokogawa were not found at AMR Tech Park or anywhere in the lens; Tata Elxsi's own contact page lists only Whitefield/Hoodi, no Hosur Road office; Red Hat and Reltio appear in OSM at IBC and AMR but their own pages now give Bagmane Constellation and RMZ Ecoworld, so both OSM entries are stale and were dropped; Practo's OSM Bannerghatta node is stale (its site now gives Clayworks, Koramangala); Myntra's AKR Tech Park HQ is 'previously Myntra HQ' per BHIVE with no exit date, so it is omitted and noted on the park; VMware/Broadcom nodes in JP Nagar (Kalyani Vista area) could not be checked and were left out; Convergys/Concentrix, CSG, WinWire, V2Soft and Valtech OSM nodes around DivyaSree Towers are unverified and omitted; 'Prestige?' and 'Apollo? (no hospital)' produced no non-hospital office; Royal Meenakshi Mall and Gopalan Innovation Mall have no verified office tenants. LOW-CONFIDENCE INCLUSIONS (OSM only, flagged): Oracle at Kalyani Magnum; Accenture at RMZ Futura and BDC-9; Ather Energy, LAPP India and Allegion at IBC; HGS House and HGS at AMR; MetricStream, Avaya, HL Mando, Visionet and Mindteck at AMR; HSBC at RMZ Futura; Safran Engineering Services in JP Nagar 7th Phase; Kaleyra at Meu Square; Cleartrip and Porter on Bannerghatta Road; Wipro M3/M4 Madiwala. Honeywell's Doraisanipalya campus is recorded active/low because Honeywell's own locations page omits it; its Bellandur Campus 2 and Sagility's Electronic City (Surya Wave) and Brillio's Sarjapur 'The Hub' offices were confirmed from primary pages but could not be geocoded, so they are omitted rather than given invented coordinates. OUT-OF-LENS ADDITIONS for the merger: Honeywell RMZ Ecoworld lease (2026), ACL Digital Prestige Shantiniketan, Sagility Global Village, Tally Raheja Arcade, Brillio RMZ Ecospace, Accenture Pritech Park, WeWork Prestige Cube, Wipro K1, Safran Bellandur. Red Hat (Bagmane Constellation) and Reltio (RMZ Ecoworld) were verified from their own pages but not added since they are no longer in this lens. Factories recorded by OSM in Bommanahalli (Shahi Exports, Peter England/ABFRL) and British Biologicals at Arekere were not included for lack of any non-OSM source. Headcounts and park areas were not stated by any source consulted and are null.
